exclusions.name: Other village officials or staff
exclusions.why_safe: Only council members vote on ordinances; others have no role in the vote outcome.

exclusions.name: Public comment or lobbying
exclusions.why_safe: Council rules do not allow public input to change the voting procedure or quorum requirements.

exclusions.name: Legal challenges or external review
exclusions.why_safe: The question is about adoption at the session; post-adoption challenges do not affect the vote itself.

uncertainties.meaning: Whether Okonkwo, as sponsor, moves to postpone the item before the vote is taken. The rules allow postponement, and her intention is unknown.
